philosophy.headline: Weddings are emotional family milestones;
philosophy.subheading: In an era of disposable reels and staged checklists, we focus on what truly matters. We capture each wedding with patience and care—honouring both the sacred Vedic rituals and the fleeting, quiet glances that go unnoticed by the crowd.
paragraphs: We believe that real memories require authenticity. Rather than forcing you into uncomfortable, stiff poses or interrupting rituals with harsh flash lights, we move quietly throughout your celebrations—anticipating a father's tear before the bidaai, noticing hands gently reassuring each other during the pheras, and capturing the energy on the sangeet floor.

Every wedding story we document receives our full attention. To guarantee personal presence, emotional devotion, and handcrafted album delivery, we accept a limited number of wedding commissions each season.
philosophy.quote: A photograph is a memory you can hold. Forty years from now, when the music has faded and the wedding garments are stored away, these pictures will let you relive exactly how loved and joyful you felt on that day.
philosophy.quote_author: — Aarav & Maya Kulkarni, Founders & Lead Photographers

featured_stories.headline: Love stories told as heartfelt
featured_stories.subheadline: Each wedding is captured as an emotional visual story—balancing the grand heritage architecture with quiet, intimate human moments.

stories.setting: The Leela Palace, Lake Pichola, Udaipur
stories.narrative: A three-day royal Marwari celebration on the shimmering waters of Lake Pichola. Rohan and Meera arrived by ceremonial royal boat as sunset reflected off the historic palace arches.
stories.extended_story: From the intimate family dawn haldi rituals on the lakeside terraces to a high-voltage sangeet under fairy lights that went on until 4 AM, we captured every spontaneous tear and laughter. The golden hour light across the palace courtyards was pure poetry.

primary_photo.alt: Rohan & Meera walking through palace courtyard in Udaipur
primary_photo.caption: Rohan & Meera ascending the palace courtyard stairs during sunset.

secondary_macro_photo.alt: Handcrafted polki jewelry and intricate bridal mehendi details
secondary_macro_photo.caption: Heirloom polki necklace and traditional bridal mehendi.

stories.narrative: A breezy coastal sunset wedding under lush coconut palms, followed by a barefoot after-party right on the white sands of Majorda Beach.
stories.extended_story: Aditya and Ananya wanted their celebration to feel warm, joyful, and completely relaxed. We documented their vibrant morning haldi splash in the pool, an emotional sunset pheras mandap decorated with fresh tuberose, and non-stop dancing under open coastal stars.

primary_photo.alt: Aditya & Ananya embracing along the sunset coastal path
primary_photo.caption: Sunset portraits amid the swaying coconut palms in South Goa.

secondary_macro_photo.alt: Tender close-up of Ananya smiling through happy tears
secondary_macro_photo.caption: Spontaneous laughter during the garland exchange ceremony.

stories.narrative: A serene forest mandap overlooking the Sahyadri mountains with marigold canopies, earthen diyas, and authentic Maharashtrian rituals.
stories.extended_story: Set against the misty hills of the Western Ghats, Kabir and Tanvi celebrated their union with intimate family rituals. Tanvi wore her grandmother's heirloom Paithani saree in deep peacock blue, while Kabir's joyful baarat featured live dhol-tasha beats.

primary_photo.alt: Kabir & Tanvi in traditional Maharashtrian wedding attire
primary_photo.caption: The sacred pheras in front of the open-air floral mandap.

secondary_macro_photo.alt: Warm brass lamps and traditional marigold arrangement
secondary_macro_photo.caption: Traditional brass samai oil lamps and fresh marigold petals.

testimonials.title: Love letters from couples who trusted us
testimonials.subtitle: Reading these words from our couples and their families reminds us why we love documenting Indian weddings. Here are excerpts from genuine notes sent to our studio.

letters.letter_text: Looking back through our wedding album, Aarav and Maya did not just capture what our wedding looked like; they preserved exactly how it felt. When Meera's father saw the picture of him gently placing his hand on her head before the bidaai, he broke down in tears. It is the most precious gift our family will cherish for generations.
letters.highlight: They preserved exactly how it felt—every real emotion.

letters.letter_text: We were both nervous about being photographed—we are shy and hated the thought of stiff poses. Aarav and Maya blended right in like old friends; we forgot cameras were even pointed at us. The pictures look like stills from a classic Mani Ratnam film. Our families still can't stop raving about the album.
letters.highlight: The pictures look like stills from a classic movie.

letters.letter_text: When sudden rain showers started just before our open-air pheras, other photographers might have panicked. Aarav and Maya quickly protected their gear, embraced the mist, and turned the moody Sahyadri weather into the most magical afternoon of our lives. The framed prints in our living room bring smiles every morning.
letters.highlight: Turned the moody mountain mist into pure magic.
